name: AI Agents Map
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Your AI setup on one map: coding agents with plan, limits and usage, local LLMs (llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, Jan, KoboldCpp) and their models, MCP servers and skills. Connect by drawing a line, with preview and Undo; install, update and sign in from each box's menu. Projects: a team of your agents plans and runs work in a folder, step by step, only when you click. Plus Ask AI, Reports, a 3D map, drag and drop, keyboard shortcuts and update badges.
